crux.warning.dropOnToken: Drop the item on a token to use it
crux.warning.holdTargetKey: Hold the targeting key while dropping to use the item
crux.warning.drop-no-permission: You do not have permission to add items to {name}.
crux.warning.drop-item-unresolved: Crux could not resolve the dropped item.
crux.warning.drop-select-one-actor: Select one active actor before dropping items onto Crux.
crux.warning.drop-no-active-actor: No active actor is available for this drop.
crux.error.itemNotFound: Could not find the dragged item

keybindings.toggle-skills-hint: The skill list placement can be selected in the module settings. When using a collapsible list, if the panel is already open, this will toggle skills open and closed and if the tray is not open, it will be opened with skills visible. When the skill list is placed at the bottom, this key will scroll to reveal the skill list.
keybindings.item-drag: Hold to drag items onto targets
keybindings.item-drag-hint: While holding this key, hover over an item and drag it onto a token to use the item on that target

settings.tray-display-hint: Toggle - only hide tray when toggled (using hot key) / When token selected - Hide the tray if no tokens are selected, show otherwise / Automatic - Toggle for players, When token selected for the GM
settings.assume-default-character-hint: When no other token is selected, show the tray for the user's default character (usually only set for players). This can help with scenes with no tokens (or a generic party token) visible.
settings.use-control-button: Include a toggle button in token controls
settings.show-no-uses: Show items with no uses left
settings.show-unprepared-cantrips: Show cantrips even if they are not prepared
settings.skill-mode-hint: If "Collapsible at the top" is selected, the skill toggle hot key (in control settings) can be used to toggle the skill list open and closed, opening the panel if needed. If skills are at the bottom of the panel, the hotkey automatically scrolls to reveal them.
settings.skill-mode-append: At the bottom of the panel
settings.skills-expanded-hint: Choose whether the Skills section starts open or collapsed by default
settings.main-sections-expanded-hint: Choose whether the main sections (like Features, Spells, etc.) start open or collapsed by default
settings.sub-sections-expanded-hint: Choose whether sub-sections (like spell levels) start open or collapsed by default
settings.use-tidy5e-sections-hint: When enabled, recognizes and uses Tidy 5e Sheet sections instead of standard Crux sections
settings.show-favorites-section-hint: Display the Favorites section in the tray
settings.show-equipped-section-hint: Display the Equipped section in the tray
settings.show-features-section-hint: Display the Features section in the tray
settings.show-spells-section-hint: Display the Spells section in the tray
settings.show-inventory-section-hint: Display the Inventory section in the tray
settings.show-all-npc-items-hint: Display all items for NPCs in the tray, not just passive ones

allow-player-scene-elevation.name: Allow Players Scene Elevation
allow-player-scene-elevation.hint: Allow players to use Scene elevation mode in the Crux elevation flyout. Players never see the scene level selection list.

auto-select-first-activity.name: Auto-select First Activity
auto-select-first-activity.hint: When enabled, Crux will automatically use the first activity without showing the activity selection dialog. When disabled, the system handles activity selection according to its own rules.

clear-targets-on-drag-target.name: Clear Targets on Drag Target
clear-targets-on-drag-target.hint: When enabled, dragging a Crux item onto a token clears previous targets before targeting the new token.

process-compendium-items.name: Process Compendium Items
process-compendium-items.hint: When enabled, Crux will process items in unlocked compendiums to set tray visibility flags. Disable this if you experience performance issues during startup.

exclude-container-items.name: Exclude Items Within Containers
exclude-container-items.hint: If enabled, items stored inside container items (like backpacks or pouches) will not be displayed in the Crux tray
